title: Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.31995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study scaling laws for full-batch gradient descent with general stable deterministic learning rates in sketched multiclass softmax regression. In a Gaussian teacher student model with power law feature and teacher spectra, the student observes a random feature sketch and reuses a finite labeled sample throughout optimization. Sketching generally makes the student misspecified, so the analysis must jointly account for approximation, nonlinear finite time learning, and the fixed empirical perturbation induced by data reuse. On an exponentially likely sketch event, we show that cross entropy excess and excess zero one risk share a common spectral scale, consisting of a resolution term and an effective learned dimension divided by sample size; teacher student decision disagreement follows the square root of that scale. translated_title: 草图化多分类Softmax回归中度量依赖的标度律
translated_abstract: 我们研究了草图化多分类Softmax回归中，采用一般稳定确定性学习率的全批量梯度下降的标度律。在一个具有幂律特征谱与教师谱的高斯师生模型中，学生观测到一个随机特征草图，并在整个优化过程中重复使用有限的带标签样本。草图化通常使学生模型处于误设状态，因此分析必须同时考虑近似误差、非线性有限时间学习，以及由数据重复使用引入的固定经验扰动。在一个以指数概率出现的草图事件上，我们证明交叉熵超额风险与超额0-1风险共享一个共同的谱尺度，该尺度由一个分辨率项加上有效学习维度除以样本量构成；师生决策不一致程度则遵循该尺度的平方根。由此得到的平衡给出了率最优的草图规模与累积训练时程选择，合成实验支持了所预测的（标度律）……
tldr: 该论文在高斯师生模型下证明，草图化多分类Softmax回归中交叉熵超额风险与0-1超额风险共享由分辨率项加“有效学习维度除以样本量”构成的共同谱尺度，并据此给出率最优的草图规模与训练时程选择。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that in sketched multiclass softmax regression, cross-entropy excess and excess zero-one risk share a common spectral scale (a resolution term plus the effective learned dimension divided by sample size), yielding rate-optimal sketch and cumulative training-horizon choices.
